hintsUsed.description: Hints taken on this canvas. Each takes five percentage points off the score of a later solution evaluation.
Hints taken on this canvas. Each takes five percentage points off the score of a later solution evaluation.

stale.description: True when the stored report describes different semantics than the canvas currently holds. Layout-only changes never set it. Always false when there is no stored result to be stale.

api_models__ApproveRubric.description:
Weights for an entry already in the catalog.

`baseVersion` names the version being approved, so an approval built on a
stale read is answered with a conflict instead of quietly landing on top of
somebody else's.

api_models__NewCatalogVersion.description: An edited template built on baseVersion. Only baseVersion is required: an omitted field keeps what the edited version had, while a field that is present and null is the editor stating that value.

api_models__SavedTemplate.description: A correction saved over the template itself. Every field is optional: an omitted one keeps what the template had. The weights are not among them, because a canvas pins the rubric version it was started under.

api_models__TemplateCopy.description: An edit saved under a new name, which creates a template of its own at version 1 and leaves the one it came from alone. baseVersion is optional and, when given, refuses a copy made from a read that has been overtaken.

api_models__SetSolutionRubric.description: Weights for one's own canvas. No template reference: it belongs to none.

hintsUsed.description: Present only when hints were taken before the run was accepted.

hintPenaltyPercent.description: Percentage points taken off progressPercent: five per hint.

progressBeforeHintsPercent.description: progressPercent before the hint charge, so the arithmetic can be shown.

api_models__HintTaken.description: The next part of the template this canvas started from, opened at the price of five points of the score. Nothing is charged when nothing is left to open.
